facts.fact: The record says Presidential Despacho 394/26 of 20 October 2026 authorised US$50 million for the Programa Conectividade to extend broadband to underserved areas, inside the World Bank-financed Angola Digital Acceleration Project, with every project indicator for people reaching broadband still at 0 as at 30 April 2026.
